thread:
Maya P: Quick pulse — devex release tomorrow 22:00 PT. Need final owners for: sampleapps smoke, docs freeze, changelog cutoff, and cutover watch. Who's owning sampleapps smoke and can run a full smoke at 19:30 PT?

Sam K: I can take sampleapps smoke. Will run on staging at 19:30 PT, smoke checklist attached in the PR. I expect 20-30m if no surprises. PRs: #432, #438.

Lee H: Docs freeze question — what's the official cutoff time? I have 2 small doc PRs in flight (guides + quickstart) and need to know whether to merge to main or hold to release branch.

Priya R: Changelog cutoff is 18:00 PT per the release calendar I published. Translations pipeline needs ~4h, so we should lock at 16:30 PT for anything that requires localized strings.

Jordan: Heads up — CI is red on sampleapp #432, failing `e2e:auth` intermittently. I'm bisecting, looks like a token rotation flake in staging env.

Maya P: @Sam K thanks. @Jordan can you triage and post a minimal repro? If it looks like a staging flake we can still proceed with docs + changelog, but sample smoke might slip.

Jordan: Repro steps posted in the PR comment. Quick repro:
```bash
export TEST_USER=smoketester
make e2e-auth-staging
```
Fails ~1/3 runs. Investigating auth helper expiry.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: staging-deploy at 2026-03-18T20:00:00-07:00 (UTC-7). Canary rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m if no errors.

Sam K: If auth repro is flaky I can still run the smoke but mark the flaky test as manual check and do the rest. Will report back by 20:10 PT.

Lee H: I'll hold docs merges to the release branch at 17:50 PT unless @Pete C says otherwise. I can fast-follow any last-minute copy fixes, but please don't push new integrational samples after 17:50.

Pete C: On call for docs review until 18:30 PT. I'll prioritize the quickstart PRs (the small ones Lee mentioned). Ping me if anything blocks.

Kate M: Minor ops note — if sampleapps smoke fails and we can't unblock by 21:00 PT, we should do a partial release: publish SDK + docs, and delay sampleapps rollout 24h. I don't want a hard blocker to hold the whole release.

Maya P: Agreed. Plan A: full release if sampleapps pass smoke by 20:30 PT. Plan B: docs+SDK only, sampleapps delayed. @everyone please add one-line ack in this thread with your ownership/ok.

Sam K: Ack — sampleapps smoke owner, will run at 19:30 and 20:00 (if needed).

Jordan: Ack — triaging CI flake, ping me if you need me to join smoke run.

Lee H: Ack — holding docs merges to release branch, will fast-follow urgent copy.

Priya R: Ack — changelog cutoff 18:00 PT, translation lock 16:30 PT.

Pete C: Ack — will review docs PRs asap.

Kate M: Ack — fallback plan in place.

Maya P: Thanks all — I'll post final release signal by 20:45 PT depending on smoke. If anything changes before 19:00 PT, drop updates here. :rocket:
